examples.ja: 花も恥じらう乙女たちに囲まれ、トムは緊張を隠せなかった。
examples.en: Tom couldn't hide his nervousness at being surrounded by a group of excessively lovely maidens.

examples.ja: トムってね、メアリーが頬を赤らめ恥じらう姿に一目惚れしたらしいよ。
examples.en: Tom seems to have fallen in love with Mary at first sight looking embarrassed and blushing.
